user.title: House Chat
user.description: The family's chat in Home Assistant – and the house writes along. Nothing to set up: everyone with a person and the companion app is in it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: House Chat is already set up.

send.name: Send a message from the house
send.description: Writes in the family chat and on the phones – to those at home unless you choose otherwise.

title.name: Title
title.description: Shown in bold on the phone (optional).

to.name: To
to.description: home: those at home (everyone if nobody is) · all: everyone · or persons.

take.name: "I'll take it" button
take.description: Gone from the others' phones when someone takes it; goes to everyone if nobody does within 10 minutes.

urgent.name: Urgent
urgent.description: Comes through in quiet hours too (smoke, water, alarm).

camera.name: Picture from a camera
camera.description: A snapshot goes with the message.
